$comment: Committed factory config. outputStyle switches on the Parker voice layer at .claude/output-styles/parker.md — the same system-prompt layer every shipped brand brain gets — so sessions in this repo talk plain and warm too. Personal overrides live in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored). permissions.allow lets a cloud routine (which starts in a checkout of this factory) run the two key steps of scripts/cloud-run-git.py without auto mode's safety check judging them; narrow rules like these stay in effect in auto mode, and nothing else is allowed (system/brain-sync.md).

hooks.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess, runpy; r = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], capture_output=True, text=True); p = Path(r.stdout.strip()) / 'scripts/usage-log.py'; runpy.run_path(str(p), run_name='__main__') if r.returncode == 0 and p.is_file() else None" hook --runtime claude
